rubric.evidence: The May-2026 revision materially misdescribed the API against today's sources: it said the event fires on individual form controls after autofill completes, cited the HTML Standard's general autofill section as the spec, and showed per-field addEventListener examples. Re-derived 2026-08-30 from the WICG Draft CG Report (2026-03-04) and Blink trunk IDL: fires at the Document BEFORE values are committed, carries autofillValues + a one-shot nullable refill callback, and adds the full-address autocomplete token. Two spec/implementation divergences verified in the raw Blink IDL and disclosed on-page: no constructor in Blink, and AutofillFieldData dictionary {field, value} versus the spec's [element, value] tuple. The correction is stated in the warn-block, not silently swapped.
